name: Ulster University
summary: Multi-campus university across Belfast, Coleraine and Derry~Londonderry, plus Jordanstown Sports Village — each with its own Uni areas and HomesNI search places.
intro: Pick your Ulster campus first, then use Uni areas for student rental search, Search places for HomesNI property browse, and Area guides where available. Belfast suits city living; Coleraine pairs with the North Coast; Magee anchors Derry~Londonderry; Jordanstown sits in the Newtownabbey corridor.

campuses.name: Belfast campus

campuses.name: Coleraine campus
campuses.notes: Riverside campus with strong North Coast student living in Portstewart and Portrush.

campuses.name: Derry~Londonderry campus (Magee)
campuses.notes: Magee campus on the city’s north side; student demand concentrates around Northland and the wider city.

campuses.name: Jordanstown Sports Village
campuses.notes: Ulster Sports Village at Jordanstown — its own Shore Road / Newtownabbey facility for sport and related student living.

faqs.question: Which Ulster campus should I choose housing for?
faqs.answer: Match housing to the campus you attend: Belfast (city / Cathedral Quarter), Coleraine (town and North Coast), Magee (Derry~Londonderry), or Jordanstown Sports Village (Newtownabbey).

faqs.question: When should I start looking for a student rental near campus?
faqs.answer: Many groups start looking from late autumn through spring for the next academic year. Popular areas near each Ulster campus go early, so it helps to search before summer if you want more choice.
